import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ['MASTER_ADDR']='127.0.0.1'; os.environ['MASTER_PORT']=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,12
    W=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,I,requires_grad=True)
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); 
        with torch.no_grad(): ref.weight.copy_(W); ref.bias.zero_()
        m=cls(I,O,True,W)
        xr=x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(); xm=x.detach().clone().requires_grad_()
        yr=ref(xr); ym=m(xm)
        assert torch.allclose(yr,ym,atol=1e-5)
        (yr**2).sum().backward(); (ym**2).sum().backward()
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            gw=torch.chunk(ref.weight.grad,ws,0)[rank]; gb=torch.chunk(ref.bias.grad,ws,0)[rank]
        else:
            gw=torch.chunk(ref.weight.grad,ws,1)[rank]; gb=ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(gw,m.weight.grad,atol=1e-5)
        assert torch.allclose(gb,m.bias.grad,atol=1e-5)
        assert torch.allclose(xr.grad,xm.grad,atol=1e-5)
    if rank==0: print('ok', ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':
    for i,ws in enumerate((1,2,4)):
        mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29600+i),nprocs=ws)
